title: DSES v0.2.0-rc8 Outcome-Layer Events
description: Two-level events on the cohort governance chain and per-case track chains. No self-reported capability, assurance, or state labels are permitted: the verifier derives them from evidence. Protocol hashes are bare lowercase SHA-256 hex. event_hash preimage: RFC 8785 canonical form of the event with integrity.event_hash, signatures, and payload removed.

initial_payload_disposition.description: Disposition at creation. Current disposition is replay-derived from later outcome_integrity_event records and is never written back into this immutable event.

allOf.description: Low-entropy payloads require randomized hiding commitments (Section 3.2).

integrity_block.description: Integrity class is a configuration claim. Capabilities and rewrite detection are NOT stored here; they are derived by the verifier (Section 3.7).

definition_set.description: Pinned references to every definition artifact in force at genesis. Snapshots must equal this set as amended.

membership_multiplicity.description: v0.2 supports one membership token per eligible decision instance; repeated encounters require distinct tokens.

cutoff_relation.description: Prespecification is judged against a declared external cutoff, not against whether outcomes happen to have been ingested yet (Section 3.4).

p_checkpoint_committed.description: The checkpoint log is append-only: each leaf is a head OBSERVATION at an epoch, never a replacement of a previous head. This is what makes RFC 9162 consistency proofs applicable (Section 3.3).

head_observations.description: The head observations appended at this epoch, so the root is recomputable by an offline verifier. Deployments above the inline threshold carry per-case inclusion proofs instead.

population_commitment.description: One tree over canonical (case_ref, chain_ref, case_chain_head, case_chain_sequence) tuples, binding each case to its exact evidence state.

population_tuples.description: The committed population, shipped so the root is recomputable and metrics can be recomputed against frozen state.

p_case_track_created.description: Genesis of every eligible case, linked or not. Carries the membership leaf so the inclusion proof is self-contained. No track_state: state is replayed from attempts (Sections 6.1-6.2).

manifest_ref.description: Event hash of the eligibility_manifest_committed event whose tree contains this leaf. Periodic manifests are first-class; the verifier aggregates denominators across them.

p_linkage_attempted.description: Records an attempt RESULT only. Track state is derived by replay, never asserted alongside the result (Section 6.1).

linkage_security.description: Method-specific security descriptors. A method name is not a security property (Section 6.5).

known_cryptanalysis_disclosure.const: Bloom-filter encodings have published practical cryptanalysis, including against hardened variants, and are not represented as private.

p_adjudicated.description: Each determination is its own event with its own identity. A revision is a new adjudication citing the one it revises; there is no nested-payload revision event (Section 6.8).

p_anchor_evidence_recorded.description: Anchor evidence recorded outside the object it attests. The event name states what it is: recorded evidence. Whether the target is externally anchored is DERIVED by verifying the receipt (Section 3.5).

decision_sequence_ref.description: A resolvable, replayable reference to the DSES v0.1 decision sequence this outcome evidence is about. The verifier resolves and replays it; an unresolvable reference is a conformance failure (Section 6.3).
